Title: Additional presses to continue: before applying effect of Trap?

Messages.Author: d
Messages.Body:
2 minions in combat with a trap.

Can 1 of them Press to Continue (Dead-end Alley or similar -cycling) or
does the press from the trap take precedence/preclude additional
presses to continue unless someone has pressed to end against the trap.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
d wrote:
